name: Aso Kiriri
source:
A Major belonging to the Living Dead Countermeasures Division of the Organized Crime Department within the Public Order Bureau of the Military Police.

Taken in by [url=/c41456]Kibanohara Hokoyasu[/url] at a young age. A dependable sister figure for [url=/c34598]Ethica[/url].

[From the in-game profile]

[Spoiler]She is the biological daughter of [url=/c165799]Aso Yukari[/url] and most likely a "designer baby".[/spoiler]
